title: "Research"

Papers on climate policy and climate finance for finance ministries and development banks, in seven series. Each series page gives the abstracts and the slides, policy brief and full paper for every paper. Older papers, books and essays are under [More papers and books](research/more.qmd).

### [1. Carbon Pricing](research/1-carbon-pricing.qmd)
